lines.text: We require SAML single sign-on for our eighty field crew members.
We support Okta and Azure AD through standard SAML two-point-zero.
SAML single sign-on will be delivered within ten days of contract signing.
What is our overall target go-live date for the field teams?
We commit to standard go-live implementation within forty-five days.
Can the system ingest aerial drone roof measurements?
I will ask engineering if we can support drone telemetry later this year.
Understood, that sounds like a good plan for phase one.
